| | |

| Category | [Shape Ops](../categories/shape-ops.md) |
| Status | Runs |
| Search words | permute, transpose, axes, shape, tensor |

## Inputs

| Pin | Type | Required | Connections | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Input** | Tensor | Yes | 1 | Tensor whose sample dimensions will be reordered |

## Outputs

| Pin | Type | Required | Connections | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Output** | Tensor | Yes | 1 | Tensor with dimensions in the requested order |

## Settings

| Group | Setting | Key | Type | Default | Allowed values | Read by | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Shape | Dimension Order | `dims` | Text | (empty) |   | The run | Comma-separated dimension order containing every input axis once. Required. |

**Read by** says whether a run uses the setting (**The run**) or only the editor, a dialog or a view (**The editor only**).

## Where it runs

| Where | Runs |
| --- | --- |
| Data pipeline (run the graph, **Run step**, previews) | No: Permute is a tensor graph utility node; PipelineExecutor tensor shape execution is not implemented |
| Training (the compiled model) | Yes, as a layer of the model: compiled and built as a tensor dimension permutation layer |

The node runs on the device chosen for the run (CPU or a GPU); a node does not fix a device.

## Tips

- Common: (N,C,H,W) -> (N,H,W,C) for channels_last.
- No data copy, just changes strides.
